An unmatched [ in a link label is escaped so the link survives

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<a href=\"S\">[A;B)</a>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
